text: To whomsoever the soil at any time belongs, to him belong the fruits of it. White parasols, and elephants mad with pride are the flowers of a grant of land.

The widow is gathering nettles for her children’s dinner; a perfumed seigneur, delicately lounging in the ̸il de B̹uf, bath an alchemy whereyby he will extract from her the third nettle, and call it rent
